headline.detail: Pew Research measured 78% smartphone ownership among U.S. adults 65+ in 2025; the rest carry a basic cellphone or nothing at all — shut out of every app- and headset-based way to reach family. That gap is why Keeper exists.
headline.source: Pew Research Center — Mobile Fact Sheet, 2025

stats.label: U.S. adults report feeling lonely
stats.note: 34% of adults, population-weighted across 2,299 counties in CDC's 2025 loneliness map; the median county rate is 32.6%.
stats.source: CDC PLACES 2025 — Loneliness among adults, by county

stats.label: a day — the risk of disconnection
stats.note: The 2023 U.S. Surgeon General advisory puts the mortality risk of social disconnection on par with smoking up to 15 cigarettes a day.
stats.source: U.S. Surgeon General Advisory on Loneliness and Isolation, 2023

album.en: The church in our town had two bells. One for morning, a deeper one for storms.
album.es: La iglesia de nuestro pueblo tenía dos campanas. Una para la mañana, otra más grave para las tormentas.

album.en: Your grandfather fished at night. I'd leave a lamp in the window so he could find the shore.
album.es: Tu abuelo pescaba de noche. Yo dejaba una lámpara en la ventana para que encontrara la orilla.

phrases.es: Mueve la luz a la izquierda.
Mueve la luz a la derecha.
